objective: Test whether capture-branch-expansion enrichment is robust to one-factor changes in evaluation profile, search implementation, and fixed search depth.

independence.rationale: Use a new seed block for independence from E-002 and E-010, while reusing the same opening seeds across E-011 conditions to reduce opening-composition noise.

primaryPopulation.reason: Preserve the E-010 terminal-distance restriction and the full eight-ply post-candidate window.

primaryEndpoint.name: condition-specific capture-branch-expansion enrichment
primaryEndpoint.candidateNumerator: A candidate members classified as capture-branch-expansion in the primary population
primaryEndpoint.candidateDenominator: All A candidate members in the primary population
primaryEndpoint.controlNumerator: Eligible control plies classified as capture-branch-expansion under the same condition
primaryEndpoint.controlDenominator: All eligible control plies under the same condition
primaryEndpoint.effectMeasure: candidate rate divided by condition-specific control rate

sampleSizeDesign.note: This calculation fixes E-011 sample size only and does not revise E-010 criteria or interpretation.

conditionDecisionRule.insufficient: Corpus integrity passes but one or more minimum count criteria fail.
conditionDecisionRule.fail: Minimum count criteria pass but one or more enrichment criteria fail.
conditionDecisionRule.inconclusive: Corpus generation, schema validation, or source-condition integrity fails.

globalDecisionRule.robust: C0 passes and all four perturbation conditions C1-C4 pass.
globalDecisionRule.partiallyRobust: C0 passes, at least three of C1-C4 pass, and no perturbation condition fails; any remaining condition must be insufficient.
globalDecisionRule.notRobust: C0 fails, at least two perturbation conditions fail, or any evaluable condition has risk ratio less than or equal to 1.
globalDecisionRule.inconclusive: Any outcome not classified above, including integrity failure or unresolved sample insufficiency.

secondaryEndpoints: primary candidate count per 100 games by condition
candidate and control expansion rates by condition
risk-ratio range and minimum risk ratio across conditions
A-archetype count and signature distribution by condition

executionPolicy.reason: The research plan reserves large self-play and formal statistics for a fixed local environment; GitHub Actions is limited to tests and artifact validation.

changePolicy: Any change after this commit must create a new preregistration version and may not silently replace this file.
